description.value: The Onyx Knights of the Shadeward Manor are clad head-to-toe in onyx plate armor. If a Knight is destroyed, its armor dissolves to dark smoke which seeps downwards into the floor.

Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

The Onyx Knight attacks with its shadowy longsword.

Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 4) cold damage.

The Knight wreaths their blade in shadow and slashes through the air, sending a wave of biting, unnatural cold at their enemy.

The Onyx Knight utters an unintelligible command or warning to an ally it can see within 30 feet. That ally gains an additional +1d4 situational bonus to its next Attack Roll, or Ability Check.

A creature can benefit from only one Dark Guidance die at a time.

Recharges on a 5+ roll of 1d6.

The Onyx Knight adds 2 to its AC against one melee Attack that would hit it.

To do so, the knight must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
The Onyx Knights of the Shadeward Manor have circular shields made out of dark metal. If a Knight dies, its shield dissolves into black smoke which seeps downwards into the floor.
The Onyx Knight has advantage on saving throws against any effects that turn undead.
